svg.title: Party wheel — orbit overview and talent panel
svg.desc: Comparison prototype. Small talent markers orbit unlocked tier keystones only. Locked keystones have no orbit rings or talent markers. Strike tier two is selected, with its four talents shown in the right panel. This SVG illustrates the selected state; it is not interactive. Talent names, effects and costs are illustrative.
svg.text: COMPARISON B / Select a keystone to inspect its talents.
Small markers show investment. Select the large keystone to make a choice.
Filled = learned · Hollow = available · Second orbit = next tier
Strike strengthens your next Light effect.
Extend the Light effect applied by Strike.
Strike pushes the target’s actions back.
Spend 1 Light point to learn this talent.
Other keystones stay visible while you choose.
Select another keystone to change this panel.
STATIC CONCEPT · Talent names, effects and costs are illustrative.
